name: Jobilize
business_model: free employer posting via web interface; job boards and aggregators need separate contact
notes: Job search engine with an employer posting interface. The posting FAQ says a job feed is set up through support on request. No API documentation URL, headquarters, parent company, language selector or partner program was found.

review.note: Posting FAQ states free employer posting and a job feed on request; About page states no headquarters or parent and there is no language selector.
